## Summary
What player-facing or development outcome does this PR deliver?

## Problem
What is missing or incorrect today? What should happen instead?

## Proposed solution
Explain the approach and important decisions.

## Scope and non-goals
- [ ] All changed files contribute to the same Issue outcome.
- [ ] No unrelated cleanup, feature or architecture change is included.
- [ ] Important non-goals and known limitations are stated.

## Related issue
Use `Closes #N` only when completed; `Part of #N` for partial delivery; `Related to #N` for context.

## Implementation notes
Describe responsibilities, data flow, scene/resource changes and compatibility impact when relevant.

## Tests and verification
Record actual commands and observed results. Do not check an item unless it was run.
- [ ] Python validator unit tests passed.
- [ ] Naming and Markdown validation passed.
- [ ] .NET Release tests passed.
- [ ] Godot editor/import/build checks passed (when relevant).
- [ ] Affected player journey was manually verified (when relevant).
- [ ] Untested items and reasons are listed.
